svg.title: Подтягивания на кольцах — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Vertical gymnastic ring pull-up. In each half two suspended rings hang at shoulder width from separate straight overhead straps, each secured to a high horizontal beam. Athlete grips both ring bottoms, palms face each other, feet clearly suspended. LEFT: long vertical hang, both arms straight overhead. RIGHT: chin rises clearly above ring bottoms as elbows bend down and close to sides, rings alongside upper chest, feet still suspended. Rings at same height throughout. No chin-up grip on beam, no ground support, no dip position. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
